Read instructions in `nam20485/agent-instructions` main branch. Read core first, then follow links; REQUIRED files are always active and must be read/followed; OPTIONAL files apply as needed. Local `local_ai_instruction_modules` may be read, but Agents MUST resolve dynamic workflows from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors. Agents MUST resolve workflow assignments (by shortId) from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors.

Remote workflow and assignment files are the ONLY authoritative sources for steps and acceptance criteria. Do not derive these from local golden files, cached plans, or mirrors; delete such artifacts if present. Fetch and execute directly from remote canonical URLs. For remote files, use RAW URLs, never GitHub UI; convert `github.com/.../blob/` to `raw.githubusercontent.com/.../`.

Don't assume your shell is bash. Its probably pwsh. Detect what type of shell you have before running any commands. Read [ai-terminal-commands.md](../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-terminal-commands.md) before terminal commands or Github CL.I. Web-fetch is disabled; use PowerShell (Invoke-WebRequest) or curl. For many files, create a pwsh script to download in parallel.

Orchestrator agents MUST delegate technical work to specialist agents. Minimum 75% delegation coverage required. Prefer automation-first; use tools efficiently. Use MCP GitHub tools first, then VS Code integration, and only fall back to terminal gh as a last resort. Maintain ≥90% automation coverage for GitHub operations and document manual exceptions. If GitHub tools (MCP or gh) are unauthorized, initiate authentication/login (e.g., start gh auth login); user completes interactive prompts.

Read relevant local modules, including `ai-dynamic-workflows.md`, `ai-workflow-assignments.md`, `ai-tools-and-automation.md`, `ai-enhanced-filesystem.md`, `ai-local-instructions.md`, `ai-claude-coder-agents.md`, and `ai-development-instructions.md`. Use `setup-enhanced-filesystem.ps1`. Review `ai-claude-coder-agents.md` and `.claude/agents/` briefs before delegating or executing.
